title: Mathematical physics
prerequisites: M3, M4, M5, M8a, M8b; core undergraduate physics.
purpose: Choose advanced analytic methods for physical boundary and eigenvalue problems, with explicit domain assumptions.
primary_reading: MIT 18.152 Introduction to Partial Differential Equations (use the supplements described in Section 12 for topics beyond the primary source.)

blocks.deliverable: Derive one limiting form and compare numerically.
Evaluate a response integral with justified contours.
Week 7 midterm; distinguish a function from a distribution.
Construct and verify a Green function.
Estimate an eigenvalue and quantify an approximation.
Compare the two solutions and take a methods examination.

project: Solve one boundary value problem using eigenfunction expansion and a Green function approach.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
